item.title: Council approves $4.4 million drainage project for west Katy
item.description: The project involves installing more than one mile of new storm sewer pipe up to 54 inches in diameter, as well as asphalt pavement overlays and concrete street panel replacements. The project also includes realigning Franz Road...

item.title: Mayor Thiele names Dana Massey Interim Fire Chief, First Woman to Lead Department following Chief Parker's planned Feb. 2 retirement
item.description: The Katy City Council Monday approved the appointment of Dana Massey as interim fire chief as current Chief Kenneth Parker plans to retire Feb. 2, 2026.

item.title: Carl Little Named New CEO of Houston Methodist West Hospital in Katy Area
item.description: Carl Little, senior vice president of Houston Methodist and CEO of Houston Methodist Clear Lake Hospital, will become the next CEO of Houston Methodist West Hospital in April.

item.title: Royal ISD receives $58,000 grant from Grundfos Foundation for music equipment, district programs
item.description: Royal ISD will receive $58,000 from the Grundfos Foundation to purchase music equipment and support seven other district programs, officials announced Thursday.

item.title: Katy ISD to launch a statewide virtual high school with enrollment starting Feb. 2
item.description: Katy Independent School District will begin enrolling students Feb. 2 for its new online high school serving students statewide.

item.title: Stacks of stolen Katy mail recovered after Sugar Land traffic stop
item.description: SUGAR LAND, Texas — A traffic stop early Wednesday led to the arrest of a man accused of possessing stolen mail and a universal mailbox key, according to Sugar Land police.

item.title: 100 attend watch party for Goodtaste with Tanji feature on Katy and its restaurants
item.description: About 100 people gathered Saturday morning at Katy Beer Garden to watch themselves and Katy featured on a popular regional television program spotlighting the city's culinary scene.

item.title: Taylor defeats Bonin for Ward A Katy City Council seat
item.description: Katy High School Paula Taylor defeated contractor Cara Bonin Saturday in a special election to fill an open seat.
